flags.why: Bim bim refers to packaged crunchy snacks generally, so restricting it to potato chips gives the wrong category ([reference](https://daophucsen.vn/cac-loai-bim-bim-snack/)).
The example defines ghe instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy thấy đau ở ghe. = She felt pain in her clitoris.

flags.why: Nhà băng remains in current everyday use, so dated misleadingly suggests it is outdated ([reference](https://baomoi.com/tai-sao-goi-ngan-hang-la-nha-bang-c53317903.epi)).
The example explains what móp is instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Bà hái đọt móp về làm dưa. = She picked móp shoots to pickle.
